Guava pastelitos.d: Puff pastry sealed around guava paste and cream cheese, baked golden and brushed with syrup.
Guava pastelitos.note: Out of the oven every hour till close.

Gold token cookies.d: Butter shortbread cut the size of a subway fare, a hole punched through the middle and a brush of gold lustre.
Gold token cookies.note: Good for a cookie. Not a ride.

Token booth honey roasted nuts.d: Almonds, cashews and peanuts glazed with cinnamon sugar and a pinch of salt, turned in a hot oven until glossy. Sold warm in a paper cone.

Arroz con pollo.d: Thighs browned hard, then laid on long-grain rice cooked slow with onion, green pepper, garlic, cilantro, achiote, green olives and capers.

Money Train payday michelada.d: Cold lager over ice with lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire, in a glass rimmed with chili salt. To go, the bottle rides in a paper bag.
